## Progress Report: Quartermaster Log Verification

**Status**: ✅ All 28 tests passing. Flat-file design locked, corruption detection strict.

### No SQLite, Zero Dependencies

Kept the design as flat JSONL (one event per line), readable with `cat`. No databases, no tooling dependencies. At 3am when something breaks, you can read the log directly from the terminal without installing anything.
